skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of scientific forecasting, classify forecasting methods, and comprehend the relationship between forecasting and macroeconomic and microeconomic management tools.

Analyze and evaluate past and current development processes of socio-economic phenomena, identify trends and factors affecting the forecasted object and environment, and choose appropriate forecasting approaches and models.
Collect, analyze, and process information and data for forecasting tasks.
Develop skills in building forecasting models and performing forecasting tasks manually and using software tools such as Eviews, Stata, SPSS, and Excel.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate forecasts and integrate forecasting results into management and policy planning.
Develop skills in teamwork, reading, writing, presenting, and debating professional content.
Foster a sense of self-study and research to accumulate knowledge and develop forecasting practical skills.
Understand professional ethics and social responsibility.
